turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need to change my upcoming flight from Newark on May 21. I’m hoping to switch to a nonstop flight on the same day if possible. My mom is really sick and I need to get home sooner to take care of her. Can you help me with this?

I can help you with changing your flight. To get started, I’ll need your user ID and the reservation ID for your current booking. If you don’t know your reservation ID, please provide your user ID and I can help locate it for you.

Could you please provide your user ID?
Sure, my user ID is ivan_rossi_8555. I don’t have my reservation ID handy right now.

Thank you for providing your user ID. You have several reservations under your profile. To proceed, could you please confirm the destination of your upcoming flight from Newark on May 21? This will help me identify the correct reservation to modify.
The destination is Milan. I’m flying from Newark to Milan on May 21.

I checked your reservations, but I do not see a booking from Newark (EWR) to Milan on May 21. Your current reservations are for other destinations and dates.

Could you please confirm if the flight from Newark to Milan was booked under a different name, user profile, or if there might be a typo in the date or airport? If you have any additional details (such as the airline, booking reference, or passenger names), please provide them so I can assist you further.

I’m sure I booked it under my name, Ivan Rossi, and this user profile. The flight should be on May 21 from Newark to Milan. Maybe there’s a slight difference in the date or airport—could you check for flights around that date, or possibly from JFK instead of EWR? I only have one profile, so it should be under this one.

I searched for direct flights from both Newark (EWR) and JFK to Milan (MXP) on May 20, 21, and 22, but I did not find any direct flights available on those dates.

If you believe you have a reservation for this route, it may be a connecting flight or under a slightly different destination airport in Milan. Could you confirm if your flight might have a layover, or if you are flying to a different Milan airport (such as LIN or BGY)? Alternatively, do you recall if your flight was a one-stop or connecting itinerary? This information will help me locate your booking and assist you with the change.

I think my current flight might have a layover, but I’d really prefer to switch to a nonstop if possible. I’m not sure which Milan airport it’s going to—maybe Malpensa or Linate. Could you check for any reservations under my name for flights from the New York area to any Milan airport around May 21? I just want to get home as quickly as possible.

I have checked all reservations under your profile, and none of them are for flights from the New York area (EWR or JFK) to any Milan airport around May 21. Your current reservations are for other destinations and dates.

If you booked the Milan flight with another airline, through a different booking platform, or under a different name/profile, it would not appear here. If you have any other details (such as a confirmation email, ticket number, or the name of another passenger on the booking), please provide them.

If you would like, I can help you book a new nonstop flight from the New York area to Milan on or around May 21. Would you like to proceed with searching and booking a new flight?

I really don’t want to buy a new ticket if possible. Is there any way you can double-check for any bookings under Ivan Rossi, maybe with a slight variation in the spelling? I’m sure I booked it with you. If not, is there any way to look up tickets using my email address or phone number? I just want to change my existing ticket, not purchase a new one.
